description: This file defines the BrowserType class, which manages launching and connecting to browser instances, including support for server launch, persistent contexts, and WebSocket/Chrome DevTools Protocol connections within the Playwright testing framework.

classes.name: BrowserType
classes.description: Represents a browser type (e.g., Chromium, Firefox) capable of launching and connecting to browser instances.

methods.name: executablePath
methods.description: Returns the executable path of the browser for this type.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the browser type.

methods.name: launch
methods.description: Launches a new browser instance with specified options.

methods.name: launchServer
methods.description: Launches a browser server if supported.

methods.name: launchPersistentContext
methods.description: Creates a persistent browser context with user data directory.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects to an existing browser instance via WebSocket endpoint.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Internal method to establish a connection to a browser.

methods.name: connectOverCDP
methods.description: Connects to a browser over Chrome DevTools Protocol.

methods.name: _connectOverCDP
methods.description: Internal method to connect over CDP.
